title: Warm Yeasty Peruvian Potatoes Papa Rellena
description: A yeasty, gooey, weeknight Peruvian dish featuring mixed spice and rest-meat, served in a tagine pot. This recipe is jain-friendly and serves as a delicious dinner option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the diced potatoes, yeast, mixed spice, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
In a large tagine pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cooked and shredded rest-meat to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the potato mixture to the pot and stir to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the mixture is hot and bubbly.
